subject: Hi {{first_name}}, Your own CS Edu Platform with our White-label Partnership
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Jonathan, founder of Codetribe.
I started a Codetribe to help nonprofits in Africa teach kids and teens how to code.

Overtime this grew into a full-scale Computer Science learning platform with easy-to-use lesson-building.

Two Reasons This May Interest You:

1. In late 2024 we decided to white-label this and allow select organizations to use it.
We’ve built a dashboard that allows each “tenant” to customize and launch their own platform in minutes - This means the entire platform on YOUR DOMAIN and with your logo.

2. Use our Curriculum and Add Your Own:
We’ve made it incredibly easy to add all types of coding lessons, as well as interactive and practical coding projects.

a. We’re expanding AI Lesson Generation to assist you with this.
b. Including an ultra-powerful “Display Engine” which allows anyone to build (with AI on Replit ) and integrate any type of learning environment in minutes - Hard to explain, but very cool! 


PRICING:

You may be thinking “That sounds too good to be true” or “Probably too expensive.” 

Well, you’ll be pleased to know our focus is on empowering other organizations - Helping YOU grow and serve YOUR customers better.

Our pricing packages are built for flexibility and scale, as you’ll see from just 3 of our CORE packages below:

Monthly CORE Platform:

1,000 users  |  $200 ( $0.20 per user)
3,000 users  |  $480 ( $0.16 per user)
10,000 users  | $960 ( $0.096 per user)


OUR ROADMAP - EMPOWERING YOU WITH A.I.

We’ve been experimenting with how to allow educators to build the CS and Coding Lessons they want in 10% of the time.


We’ve focused on:
1. Making it easier for the AI models by offering them simpler templates to build on. ( Doing all the fancy styling with templates and giving them the mission of core lesson-building.)

2. Creating pre-built lesson environments ( Display Engines) for those templates to plug into.

The result is incredibly fun and interactive lessons ( I will send some examples in my next email.)

This structure allows teachers to easily iterate and tweak new courses with AI. 

OTHER BENEFITS:

A. On-boarding & LMS UI:
The slick on-boarding UI for Teachers and learners is designed to accommodate multiple classes, topics and teachers.

B. Manage Schools:
This is by far the most insane part.
We’ve built “Schools” into the white-label. This means you can sign-up dozens of schools and each school is segmented with its own name, roster and teachers.
It comes OOTB ( out-of-the-box) with the White-label packages.


C. 50% IMPACT DISCOUNT:
For non-profits and also businesses in 121* developing  countries we offer a no-questions-asked 50% discount on core packages.

*International Co-operative Alliance (ICA) List of developing countries 2024

For state-level or large-scale roll-outs please get in touch.



I’d also be happy to send you our updated price-list and demo video.

Have an awesome day!

Jonathan

P.S.

If you think someone you know may need this, please forward it to them (or shoot me a reply and I’ll reach out.)

Well, you’ll be pleased to know our focus is on empowering other organizations - Helping YOU grow and serve YOUR customers better.

1,000 users  |  $200 ( $0.20 per user)

10,000 users  | $960 ( $0.096 per user)

1. Making it easier for the AI models by offering them simpler templates to build on. ( Doing all the fancy styling with templates and giving them the mission of core lesson-building.)

2. Creating pre-built lesson environments ( Display Engines) for those templates to plug into.

The result is incredibly fun and interactive lessons ( I will send some examples in my next email.)

This structure allows teachers to easily iterate and tweak new courses with AI. 


# OTHER BENEFITS:

A. On-boarding & LMS UI:

B. Manage Schools:
This is by far the most insane part.
We’ve built “Schools” into the white-label. This means you can sign-up dozens of schools and each school is segmented with its own name, roster and teachers.
It comes OOTB ( out-of-the-box) with the White-label packages.




C. 50% IMPACT DISCOUNT:

For non-profits and also businesses in 121* developing  countries we offer a no-questions-asked 50% discount on core packages.

*International Co-operative Alliance (ICA) List of developing countries 2024

For state-level or large-scale roll-outs please get in touch.


Have an awesome day!

Jonathan

body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Jonathan, founder of Codetribe.
I started a Codetribe to help nonprofits in Africa teach kids and teens how to code.

Overtime this grew into a full-scale Computer Science learning platform with an easy-to-use lesson-building.

Two Reasons This May Interest You:

1. In late 2024 we decided to white-label this and allow select organizations to use it.
We’ve built a dashboard that allows each “tenant” to customize and launch their own platform in minutes - This means the entire platform on YOUR DOMAIN and with your logo.

2. Use our Curriculum and Add Your Own:
We’ve made it incredibly easy to add all types of coding lessons, as well as interactive and practical coding projects.

a. We’re expanding AI Lesson Generation to assist you with this.
b. Including an ultra-powerful “Display Engine” which allows anyone to build (with AI on Replit ) and integrate any type of learning environment in minutes - Hard to explain, but very cool! 


PRICING:

You may be thinking “That sounds too good to be true” or “Probably too expensive.” 

Well, you’ll be pleased to know our focus is on empowering other organizations - Helping YOU grow and serve YOUR customers better.

Our pricing packages are built for flexibility and scale, as you’ll see from just 3 of our CORE packages below:

Monthly CORE Platform:

1,000 users  |  $200 ( $0.20 per user)
3,000 users  |  $480 ( $0.16 per user)
10,000 users  | $960 ( $0.096 per user)


OUR ROADMAP - EMPOWERING YOU WITH A.I.

We’ve been experimenting with how to allow educators to build the CS and Coding Lessons they want in 10% of the time.


We’ve focused on:
1. Making it easier for the AI models by offering them simpler templates to build on. ( Doing all the fancy styling with templates and giving them the mission of core lesson-building.)

2. Creating pre-built lesson environments ( Display Engines) for those templates to plug into.

The result is incredibly fun and interactive lessons ( I will send some examples in my next email.)

This structure allows teachers to easily iterate and tweak new courses with AI. 

OTHER BENEFITS:

A. On-boarding & LMS UI:
The slick on-boarding UI for Teachers and learners is designed to accommodate multiple classes, topics and teachers.

B. Manage Schools:
This is by far the most insane part.
We’ve built “Schools” into the white-label. This means you can sign-up dozens of schools and each school is segmented with its own name, roster and teachers.
It comes OOTB ( out-of-the-box) with the White-label packages.


C. 50% IMPACT DISCOUNT:
For non-profits and also businesses in 121* developing  countries we offer a no-questions-asked 50% discount on core packages.

*International Co-operative Alliance (ICA) List of developing countries 2024

For state-level or large-scale roll-outs please get in touch.


If you think someone you know may need this, please forward it to them (or shoot me a reply and I’ll reach out.) 

I’d also be happy to send you our updated price-list and demo video.

Have an awesome day!

Jonathan
